projects.title: Meydan Grandstand & Racecourse
paragraphs: Meydan Racecourse is a racecourse in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The grandstand is the longest single structure in the world, reaching over a mile in length, and can accommodate over 60,000 spectators in a mile-long grandstand.

Meydan is completely controlled through KNX/EIB(European Installation Bus) Based Lighting control system which is monitored and controlled through KNX Color Graphic Visualization Software & Interfaced thru BMS.

projects.title: American School of Dubai
paragraphs: The new campus of American School of Dubai in Barsha Dubai is an integrated world-class facility that has set a benchmark for schools in the region. Comprising of 6 Blocks with 138 Class rooms

All the class rooms are installed with 125 numbers of Presence sensors with LUX Meter to gave Daylight harvesting and maximum energy savings in the class rooms. Each Class rooms has an Over-ride Key switch with a mechanical Key to over-ride manually to create a scene during presentations.

projects.title: Lapita Hotel – Dubai Parks and Resorts
paragraphs: Located in Dubai Parks and Resorts , Lapita is 500 Suite rooms Polynesian Themed Family hotel. This hotel will form part of the Autograph Collection, an exclusive ensemble of independent luxury hotels within the Marriott International brand portfolio. Entire common area Lighting control system is KNX based which consists of Dimming and DMX control in Ball rooms, Meeting Rooms, Restaurants etc. Guest Rooms Management system with Energy saving solutions have been considered for all the 500 guest rooms.

projects.title: Deira Fish Market
paragraphs: In line with the vision of His Highness Shaikh Mohammad Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice-President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, of creating an environmentally sustainable city, Dubai Municipality has built the new fish market which has applied KNX based green building methods for Lighting control systems.

projects.title: Iris Bay
paragraphs: The Iris Bay is a 32-floor tower in the Business Bay in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The tower has a total structural height of 170 m. The tower is designed in the shape of an ovoid and comprises two identical double curved pixelated shells which are rotated and cantilevered over the podium. The Lighting control system implemented in this tower is KNX based to match the structure and requirements. Dali based Façade lightings are controlled using Day Light sensors and KNX Dali Gateways.

projects.title: Dubai International Cricket Stadium
paragraphs: Dubai International Cricket Stadium – Sports City With its spectacular “Ring of Fire” floodlights, next-generation bowl design that brings spectators closer to the action and ICC, one-day international sanctioned field, the 25,000-seat Dubai International Stadium has become a favorite for teams and spectators a like. KNX based lighting control system has been implemented in the common areas with using motion sensors, timers, light sensing sensors etc. The Flood lights are controlled using preset scenes to suite different kinds of situations like Cricket Match, Training sessions, Events etc.

projects.title: Westin Abu Dhabi Golf Resort and Spa
paragraphs: The Westin Abu Dhabi Golf Resort & Spa is the hospitality heart of the Abu Dhabi Golf Club, a 27-hole championship course, home to the PGA European Tour Abu Dhabi Golf Championship. The hotel features total of 176 premium rooms, executive suits and a presidential suite which overlooks the spectacular Golf Course. All the Rooms are equipped with KNX Guest Room Management System (GRMS). Some of the Key Functions include Access control system, Touch panel based lighting and AC control.

projects.title: Kempinski Hotel & Suits
projects.location: Mall of the Emirates, Dubai, UAE
paragraphs: Kempinski, a 5 Star luxury hotel that is connected to the award winning Mall Of Emirates with over 393 rooms and suits is equipped with state of the art KNX based lighting and dimming control system.

projects.title: La Verda Suites and Villas
paragraphs: La Verda Suits & Villas, located in Dubai Marina, which is an artificial canal city, build along a 2 mile stretch of Persian gulf Shoreline. La Verda,5 star suits and villas, provides all modern amenities combined with state of the art technologies in all segments. It is impeccably modern, elegantly furnished with opulent facilities having deluxe category status. KNX system implemented in apartments, suits, villas & Common areas ensures the optimal usage of Lighting & HVAC Systems thereby providing utmost energy efficiency along with enhancing the Guest Comfort. More than 150,000 of Lighting, Blind & HVAC points are being catered with more than 6500 KNX Devices. The system adheres to the International Green Building codes of High Energy Efficiency by enabling optimal usage of Lighting, HVAC by Occupancy, Lux Level, Time Schedule, Manual input and a logical combination of all these parameters. Centralized control with Visualization is provided to ensure ease of use for hotel operator.

projects.title: Dubai International Airport – Terminal 3 Concourse A
paragraphs: Dubai Airport Concourse A is one of the most modern and sophisticated Airports in the world which serves Emirates Airline and spans an area of 528,000 square meter over 11 levels which includes retail space, offices and 2 hotels. The world's only dedicated Hub(In Operation) for A380 Aircrafts and features the world's first multi-level boarding for first and business class passengers directly from the respective lounges. Dubai Airport caters up to 75 million passengers in a year. The KNX system implemented caters to more than 160000 lighting, blind & HVAC points with more than 7000 KNX Devices. The KNX system implemented in this is the state of art system which provides Energy Efciency at the highest level without any impact on the safety, comfort and convenience of the passengers and staff members of the Airport and in addition improve the aesthetics of the building . The KNX system provides Energy Efficient control of Lighting, HVAC and Blinds, Seamless integration to 3rd party systems, Complete control and monitoring from centralized location, mood lighting at spa areas of First class lounges. This will enable 30-40% of Energy Saving per annum.

products.title: 160mA Flush Power Supply
paragraphs: The Flush power supply KNX 160mA is a device to provide accurate and stable supply voltages to power KNX device in applications of building automation, access control, Lighting control system etc.
The power supply has a built-in coil, to enable KNX communication over twisted pair.
Because of their small size, these flush mounted power supplies can be mounted in wall boxes, near to the KNX devices, and enable small KNX lines.
The power supply flush mounted KNX 160mA features an overload detection to protect themselves in case of wrong or defective load, short circuit etc. So no need of fuse replacement and no maintenance.

products.title: Audiofy System
paragraphs: Audiofy is the simple yet powerful integrated multiroom professional audio system created by ThinKnx. Only one device combines audio matrix routing, power amplifiers for each output and up to four independent network players. It is also fully configurable via web. The system permits to spread audio contents from external analog sources or from internal players towards up to 32 zones with superior pure sound quality. Through KNX TP port, Audiofy acquires all the functionalities of any ThinKnx server, enabling a two-way communication with the plant. Soon, with the next software upgrade and the innovative graphic restyling of the interface (both for smartphone and for desktop versions), there will be a faster and more intuitive browsing from any mobile device.

products.title: Rack Mount Type
paragraphs: Rack is the ideal solution for all the plants where a high number of integrations and available features coexist. With many external ports to connect different systems and devices, Rack grants the highest performance and the best automation for a smart building. It embeds all the features of other ThinKnx server models without any restrictions.

products.title: Envision Touch Server
paragraphs: Thinknx Envision is the touch screen solution that combines a native KNX server and a multiplatform and highly customizable graphical UI. An all in one device for the management of all the devices installed in the plant. Envision grants a bidirectional interaction between KNX protocol and all other supported devices, such as Philips Hue, MyHome BTicino, Z-Wave, Modbus and Lutron. Its built-in sensor board, loudspeaker and microphone enable the use of Envision as doorcom unit and as a thermostat at the same time. Thanks to the integration of third-party systems, Envision can also act as indoor station for the anti-theft system.

products.title: Compact & CompactDIN
paragraphs: Compact allows an advanced automation. In addition to the standard features of the Micro server, it has an extended set of i/O's and two serial ports. It also enables the connection with different worlds such as Modbus, Lutron, BTicino MyHome and other. Moreover, it supports connections with anti-theft systems and multimedia systems such as audio and video matrix; everything can be integrated following the logics chosen by the installer or end user. Designed to achieve high performances, it does not have any limitations on the amount of configurable systems. The new 1.54” screen makes it easier to install, enabling the monitoring of the IP address and other technical information.

products.title: Micro & MicroDIN
paragraphs: Completely restyled in its drive electronics, Micro has become a more powerful device, even more performing. Native KNX, it enables the user to control lights, blinds, thermostat and all the available functionalities of a professional automation plant. It is able to process complex logic operations on the data coming from the KNX bus. Recorded data can also be stored and displayed in form of charts in the client’s application, or sent via e-mail. Another important feature is the use of IR transmitters, which allows to control smart TVs and different multimedia devices through smart phones or tablets. This device also provides integration for IP doorcoms, Philips Hue, MyHome BTicino and much more.

products.title: KNX Cable
paragraphs: The KNX/EIB cable is a European installation fieldbus BUS cable suitable for use in KNX systems, formerly known as EIB. It forms part of building control systems and intelligent building technology, improving comfort levels whilst reducing carbon footprint and running costs.

products.title: Flush DALI Gateway
paragraphs: The Flush Mounted DALI Gateway is a device for controlling and monitoring up to 8 DALI ballast. In the DALI gateway KNX input is transformed in to a DALI signal. Due to its decentralized housing it can be installed near the lighting equipment (suspend ceilings) or behind the switches to avoid additional costs of wiring

products.title: 640mA DIN Power Supply with 30V Auxillary
paragraphs: The KNX POWER SUPPLY 640 mA is a DIN Rail mounted KNX device with integrated choke to directly power a KNX line.
An auxiliary 30V output is available for some extra loads such as displays, binary inputs.

products.title: 8 Channel Push Button Interface
paragraphs: The 8 Channel Push button interface is a flush mounted device commonly used in Residential Units, Offices & Hotels.
Up to 7 of the binary inputs can be used to connect temperature sensors to measure various temperatures ( local temp, outside temp, inlet air.)
The device can interface with 8 potential free contacts to control lighting, shading or other sets of equipment.
The device can also drive 8 Status LEDs. Each LED can be set to display the status of the corresponding binary input or to display the value of a separate communication object from the KNX Bus.

products.title: Single Channel Fan Controller
paragraphs: The MOTOR CONTROL is a flush mounted KNX device for ceiling fan applications in Residential Units, Offices and Hotels. This device is used for varying ceiling fan speed as determined by KNX telegram. Speed can also be varied by push buttons directly connected to the device.
The ceiling fan must be of standard motor type, without control electronics. if using multiple speed fans always forces fan to maximum speed.

products.title: 4 Channel Switch Actuator-Flush Mounted
paragraphs: 4 Channel Switch Actuator is a flush mounted KNX device for Lighting and shading applications in Residential Units, Offices and Hotels. This device is used for switching lights controlling blinds or shutters as determined by KNX telegram. Lights and blinds/shutters can also be controlled by push buttons directly connected to the binary input of the Switch Actuator.
4 LED’s can be connected to the device to indicate Status of relays or to be driven by KNX telegrams.
